title: Kedarnath Yatra
alt: Kedarnath temple with the snow-covered Kedarnath peak behind it
summary: The 16 km trek from Gaurikund to the twelfth Jyotirlinga, with acclimatisation built into the itinerary and a night at Sonprayag before the climb.

title: Badrinath Yatra
alt: The brightly painted facade of Badrinath temple in Uttarakhand
summary: A road yatra to Badrinath with darshan at Mana village, Vyas Gufa and Bheem Pul, comfortable enough for elderly travellers.

title: Chopta - Tungnath Trek
alt: Trekkers on the ridge trail to Chandrashila summit above Chopta
summary: The world's highest Shiva temple, plus a sunrise push to Chandrashila summit for a 360 degree view of Nanda Devi, Trishul and Chaukhamba.

title: Har Ki Dun Trek
alt: The wide green cradle of the Har Ki Dun valley ringed by peaks
summary: A week in the Govind National Park through Osla and Seema, walking into the valley the Pandavas are said to have taken to heaven.

title: Valley of Flowers
alt: Alpine flowers carpeting the Valley of Flowers national park
summary: A UNESCO World Heritage site in full monsoon bloom, combined with Hemkund Sahib at 4,632 m for those who want both.

title: Char Dham Yatra
alt: Gangotri temple beside the Bhagirathi river in Uttarakhand
summary: All four dhams in one circuit - Yamunotri, Gangotri, Kedarnath and Badrinath - with rest days built in so the pace stays humane.
